tokens.name: space-12

tokens.usage: Defined on the Spacing & Grid page. Not used by a component yet; section and page spacing.

shadow.note: Figma effect styles. No dark-theme values are defined in the file, so both themes share them.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Figma "Shadow/Button". Primary and secondary buttons at rest and on hover; removed while pressed or disabled.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Figma "Shadow/Raised". Raised cards, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Figma "Shadow/Overlay". Modals, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sunken
tokens.usage: Figma "Shadow/Sunken". Inset wells, focused input fields.

tokens.name: shadow-card-course
tokens.usage: Figma "Elevation / CardCourse". Course cards.

tokens.name: shadow-picker-popover
tokens.usage: Figma "Picker Popover". Date pickers and popovers (elevation 05).

tokens.name: shadow-04-light-theme
tokens.usage: Figma "04 Light Theme". Raised cards and buttons, dropdown menus (elevation 04).

tokens.name: shadow-03-white-theme
tokens.usage: Figma "03 White Theme". Navigation menu and bars (elevation 03).

tokens.name: shadow-06-bg
tokens.usage: Figma "06 BG". Large soft shadow under modals and dialogs (elevation 06).

tokens.name: shadow-bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Figma "Bg/BgOverlay". Glass overlay panel; the style also applies a 149px background blur, which a box-shadow cannot carry.

layout.note: From the Spacing & Grid page and the two grid styles.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Column count at every breakpoint.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter between columns.

tokens.name: grid-margin
tokens.usage: Page margin of the "Desktop base" grid style.

tokens.name: container-2xl
tokens.usage: Content container on 1920px screens (12 columns of 106px).

tokens.name: container-xl
tokens.usage: Content container on 1440px screens.

tokens.name: container-lg
